hebrewText: ל֥וּא הִקְשַׁ֖בְתָּ לְ/מִצְוֺתָ֑/י וַ/יְהִ֤י כַ/נָּהָר֙ שְׁלוֹמֶ֔/ךָ וְ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֖ כְּ/גַלֵּ֥י הַ/יָּֽם

tokens.bdb: a conditional particle; if; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!
tokens.kjv: if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a conditional particle; if; by implication  would that!
tokens.enLiteralWord: a conditional particle; if; by implication  would that!
tokens.explanation: a conditional particle; if; by implication  would that!
tokens.explanationEn: a conditional particle; if; by implication  would that!

tokens.bdb: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
tokens.kjv: attend, (cause to) hear(-ken), give heed, incline, mark (well), regard.

tokens.bdb: a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)
to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.enLiteralWord: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.explanation: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.explanationEn: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile

tokens.bdb: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
tokens.kjv: [idiom] do, familiar, [idiom] fare, favour, [phrase] friend, [idiom] great, (good) health, ([idiom] perfect, such as be at) peace(-able, -ably), prosper(-ity, -ous), rest, safe(-ty), salute, welfare, ([idiom] all is, be) well, [idiom] wholly.
tokens.explanation: shalom — paz, harmonia, integridade, bem-estar, salvação

tokens.bdb: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
something rolled, i.e. a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins), by analogy, a spring of water (plural waves)

a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanation: yam — mar, lago, oceano, ocidente (o mar fica a oeste)
tokens.explanationEn: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
